subject: ancient-history
topicName: The Founding of Rome & Early Kings

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Roman legend traced Rome's origins to Aeneas (Trojan refugee) and the founding by Romulus and Remus (753 BC)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The seven kings ruled Rome from its founding until the overthrow of Tarquin the Proud (Superbus) in 509 BC

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The last king, Tarquin Superbus, was a tyrant whose son Sextus raped Lucretia, triggering the rebellion led by Brutus

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Republic (res publica = 'public thing') replaced the monarchy: power was held by elected magistrates and the Senate
